_comment: Held-out duplicate labels, written before any run. Rows are 0-based data rows (header excluded). same_person lists every group of rows that are one real person; any other pair is different people. Planted: case-changed email (0+1), nickname with personal email (2+3), reformatted phone with another work email (6+7), surname typo (10+11), nickname with same phone (14+15). Look-alikes that are different people: same name at another company (4+5, 12+13 'Sam'/'Samantha'), a shared office line (8+9).
